title: Course schedule
statement: There are n courses 0…n−1; [a, b] means you must take b before a. Return whether all courses can be finished.
hints: Possible exactly when the dependency graph has no cycle.
Kahn: repeatedly take a course with no remaining prerequisites.

solution.explanation: Kahn's algorithm: start from in-degree-0 nodes; removing one decrements its successors. If some nodes never reach in-degree 0, they lie on or behind a cycle. The DFS alternative colours nodes white/grey/black and reports a cycle on a grey→grey edge.
